notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
Vampirism attached to any creature you control, except the aforementioned additional creature.
description:
Cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/0 due to Vampirism and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.
